Darwin takes his voyage on the Beagle, looks at the natural world, and he sees a world of parasites and nastiness. And he says, how could this be? How could a good God design something like this? And you see this mixed bag in nature. And this is actually, I think, a challenge for design to make sense of also the nasties. But the thing is, it's a challenge for design, but it's not a refutation of design because we can determine whether something is designed independent of the morality or goodness or optimality of the design. So the issues run very deep, and we're not going to really be able to resolve them here. But I do want to give you some sense that there is a discussion here, and there's some interesting issues.
